items.q: Is my membership — and everything discussed — confidential?
items.a: Entirely. Your records are held under strict medical confidentiality, correspondence is unmarked, invoices are discreetly worded, and private entrance appointments are available on request. Nothing is ever shared without your explicit written consent.

Membership places are limited so the clinical team can genuinely know every member. You apply, we hold a brief confidential conversation about your goals and diagnostics, and Dr Wakil’s team confirms the tier that fits. Pricing is confirmed at application.

items.q: Do I need a membership to be treated?
items.a: No. The O Concept™ is open to everyone — single treatments and bundled packages are available to all patients, with 0% finance, and the standard of care is identical. Membership adds continuity: scheduled diagnostics, priority access and ongoing optimisation.

Yes. 0% finance is available on all treatment plans, subject to status, and memberships are billed monthly with no long-term lock-in. Our patient care team will structure whatever arrangement suits you best.

items.q: Can I pause or cancel my membership?
items.a: Of course. Memberships run month to month after an initial three-month term. You may pause for up to three months a year — travel, work, life — and cancellation requires only 30 days’ notice, in writing or by phone.
